What role do the Himalayas play in influencing the climate of India?
options: They allow tropical winds to influence India’s climate.
They prevent cold winds from entering northern India.

Between 1885 and 1905, Indian industrialists, drawing upon emerging nationalist sentiments, demanded which of the following to protect Indian industries?
options: Rupee devaluation, high import duties and end of British trade preference
Export subsidies, low tariffs and continued trade preference for Britain
Free trade policies, gold standard currency and British trade dominance
Industry nationalisation, import bans and restrictions on foreign capital
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Rupee devaluation, high import duties and end of British trade preference) है।

questions.question: Which of the following agricultural practices is the most influenced by terrain and altitude?
options: Apple orchards flourish below 1500 metres in elevation.
Paddy cultivation thrives in rolling terrains where water drains away.
Tea plantations are suited for areas with level fields and standing water.
Coconut orchards are typically found at low altitudes near the sea level.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Coconut orchards are typically found at low altitudes near the sea level.) है।
